The DDB/Archivportal-D viewer shows only 5 sample images, which is why the frame check of 30 Oct did not find the leaf.
seen.extent: One leaf: fol. 493r carries about 19 lines of symbol cipher in six or seven runs set between clear German phrases; the letter ends in clear on fol. 493v, dated 26 February 1632 (place not read with confidence).
seen.cipher: Symbol cipher (Greek-like and geometric signs with digits, monoalphabetic in look) in a German letter to Wartenberg. Each cipher run is marked with a letter (α, β, γ, δ, ε, ξ, H) and the left margin carries the matching plaintext in a contemporary hand, e.g. α 'deren Inhalt des Herrn Churfürsten in Bayern Dhlt. und Lbd. gebürlich zu communiciren', δ 'das sie auff der zu Brüssell abgelegte werbung und negotiation für eine endliche und zuverlessige resolution und erklerung erheben werde', ε 'das hauptwerck'. The decipherment is on the leaf.

627.closed: Deciphered and printed in 1935/36: G. Buschbell with R. Fuchs, 'Die Instruktion Karls V. für den Kardinal von Trient, Christoph Madruzzo, nach Rom (vom 11. Juni 1546), aus der Geheimschrift ohne Schlüssel entziffert', Archiv für Urkundenforschung 14, p. 188-210, from the Simancas Patronato Real original (notice in Historische Zeitschrift 154, 1936, p. 203). Buschbell dates it 11 June where Paz has 10 June; taken as the same document (an all-cipher instruction to Madruzzo for Rome of that week in Patronato Real). The article was not opened.
